problemStatement.formal: \text{Prove: sieve principle, Euler totient via IE, surjection counting, derangements, divisor-totient identity.}
problemStatement.plain: Formalize the inclusion-exclusion principle with applications: the sieve formula for avoiding bad sets, Euler's totient computed by IE sieve, counting surjections by IE, the derangement formula D(n) = Σ(-1)^k C(n,k)(n-k)!, the derangement recurrence, and the divisor-totient identity Σ_{d|n} φ(d) = n.
whyMatters: Inclusion-exclusion is a fundamental technique across combinatorics, probability, and number theory
Derangements appear in probability (hat-check problem) and generate subfactorials
Divisor-totient identity is key in multiplicative number theory
Surjection counting is related to Stirling numbers and Bell numbers

proven: Sieve for 2 bad sets: |U\(A∪B)| = |U| - |A| - |B| + |A∩B| (Lean proof, 0 sorries)
Sieve for 3 bad sets (Lean proof, 0 sorries)
Divisor-totient identity: Σ_{d|n} φ(d) = n (wraps Nat.sum_totient)
φ(p) = p-1 for prime p; φ(p^k) = p^(k-1)(p-1)
Surjection count definition and special cases: |Surj(n,1)| = 1, |Surj(n,2)| = 2^n - 2
Derangement count formula and recurrence D(n) = (n-1)(D(n-1)+D(n-2))
Alternating binomial sum: Σ(-1)^k C(n,k) = 0 for n≥1

currentState.focus: Formalization complete from PR #3013 — 0 sorries, 0 axioms

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: InclusionExclusionOQ01.lean has 0 sorries, 0 axioms (PR #3013). Proved: sieve_two (2-set IE), sieve_three (3-set IE), divisor-totient, totient multiplicativity, φ(pq)=(p-1)(q-1), surjection_n_1, surjection_n_2, derangement formula, derangement recurrence, alternating binomial sum. Uses Finset operations and Nat.totient infrastructure.
builtItems: InclusionExclusionOQ01.lean: surjectionCount definition and special cases
insights: Totient multiplicativity via Nat.totient_mul (coprimality hypothesis required)
φ(pq) proof: first establishes Coprime p q from hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd, then applies totient_mul
Surjection count defined as Σ (-1)^j C(k,j)(k-j)^n over range k+1
Derangement recurrence proved algebraically from the formula definition
All results verified with native_decide for concrete values
The divisor-totient Σ_{d|n} φ(d) = n is in Mathlib as Nat.sum_totient
